scope: Off-path evidence housekeeping, not benchmark capacity. Every raw file, including failed-state bytes, preserved and independently streamed/SHA256/CRC verified before removal. Sparse allocation/inode relationships are not restored. Physical device IO/latency unavailable; source bytes, archive bytes and observed filesystem free space are distinct.
compression: gzip level1 tar stream; every member independently re-read and SHA256/CRC checked before removal
reproducibility: The local ignored archive retains raw100k/million-pair histories, full exports and byte-checked native copies. Published source and lifecycle regenerate fresh experiments; tar does not restore original sparse/inode relationships. Visible source reduction is distinct from host physical-space reclamation.
